newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint closes firmer vs dlr, NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint closes firmer vs dlr, NBH basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed slightly against the dollar and the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) currency basket in afternoon trade, dealers said on Monday.
"The forint firmed slightly in the last 15 minutes of the session," said Kereskedelmi Bank's Szabolcs Brezina. "Trading was thin then and small deals moved the prices."
The forint finished at 176.22/27, compared with 176.28/33 at midday and 176.80 at the opening.
The gap from the NBH's resistance level (bid) narrowed to some 15 pips at the end of trading from about 20 pips before.
The forint tracked the dollar/mark's changes in international markets, but the dollar/mark changed little, dealers said.
They added that the current differential from the NBH bid was not likely to change much this week despite currency futures maturities on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE).
"There are a lot of open positions (on the BCE), but a substantial number of them have already been closed," Brezina said. "I don't expect large movements.
The forint floats in the NBH's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
